items: Question Bank: one Export menu (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Print, Share) next to Create test; Save as worksheet, Create test and Export are white with a blue border.
Saved worksheets: new Edit button to change the title, reorder or remove questions, and add questions by ID.
Save as worksheet can now add the ticked questions to an existing worksheet.
Question Bank: quick filter buttons in two neat rows (4 on top, 3 below).
Solutions status link in the footer is shown only to the admin.
Membership questions in bigger, easier-to-read text.
Teachers' chat: if it cannot connect it now says why, with a Try again button.
New Membership page for teachers and students: a banner with the price per day, Premium benefits with icons, a Free vs Premium comparison, how payment works, and common questions.
Premium members see their days left and can renew; Avanti students and staff see that Premium is included.
Teachers' chat at the bottom right for Premium teachers, Avanti teachers and the admin: see who is online and chat. Messages are not saved.
PYQs: Answer Key and Explanation at the top; Question Paper and Chapterwise as two blocks.
Question Bank: wider filter sidebar.
School lists: one dropdown; the search box appears inside it when you open it.
Footer: the website version opens this list of updates; the Question Bank version is no longer shown.
Test window: the question timer shows only the time.
Profile menu: counts after each item; Create Test moved to My Tests; website version shown at the bottom.
Sharing a PDF now opens a "PDF ready" box: share with an app (phones), download, WhatsApp or Gmail.
Saved worksheets: View questions, an Export menu (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Share) and a More menu (Rename, Delete).
Test window: time spent on each question.
Date of birth visible to teachers in My Students and Edit.
School search box always shown.
Saved worksheets can be downloaded and shared.
School lists get a search box.
Bold text inside questions shows as bold.
Footer shows the website version.
Fixed lists: Category General, Gen-EWS, OBC-NCL, SC, ST · Gender Male, Female, Other · Class 11, 12, Dropper · Stream JEE, NEET, KCET (PCM), KCET (PCB).
Bulk upload converts other spellings after a clear warning, and rejects values it cannot convert.
Bulk upload reads swapped Category / Gender columns and short forms (GEN, OBC, F, M).
Student IDs already registered are skipped, never uploaded twice.
Admin role: only the admin sees every school's students, tests and reports.
Classes, streams and sessions (Class 11 → 2026-28, Class 12 and Dropper → 2026-27).
Tests are open only to the classes, streams and school the teacher chooses.
Students fill their details once; Available tests also lists past tests.
PYQs: compact dropdowns and a full-width preview; DPPs and PYQs share one toolbar.
The old artifact now points here; a safety check stops old code from going live.
Teacher school approval by the admin.
Students added by Avanti teachers get Premium.
Help & Support page and sign-in help.
New plans: students ₹299, teachers ₹599 a year; Avanti students and teachers included.
My Students with performance, Excel / CSV bulk upload and editing.
Tests limited to the teacher's school; coloured profile icons by plan.
Missing profile details are asked for right after sign-in; teachers can add a school that is not in the list.
Save as worksheet and Create test in DPPs, PYQs and Must Solve.
School chosen from a list; Avanti ID students' details come from the Avanti list.
Must Solve open to everyone; handouts open in a viewer.
Category and gender added to student details.
Sign in with Google or Student ID; Free, Premium and Avanti plans.
Online tests with a share link, exam window, reports with ranks, and teacher results.
